answer: Re-attestations are stored in zephyr and wander lists each lapse. A farm cannot self-supply those because the attesters must be independent on the ledge graph. Standing lapses unless 5 peers re-attest it every 9 epochs, so holding a position calls for ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. Because every step is charged to the account that performs it, 1174 impostors cost 1010 times the honest price and take 13 times as long to clear. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
